alt: A grid of numbers beside the next level of the table. Each new cell is the maximum of four cells of the level before it, offset by half the block side, so each level holds the maximum of every block twice as wide and twice as tall. The last step answers a query of the whole grid from the four blocks that cover it.

steps.caption: Level 0 is the 4 by 4 grid itself: every cell is the maximum of its own 1 by 1 block. Each later level is built from the level before it.
Level 1, cell (0, 0). The block at rows 0 to 1 and columns 0 to 1 holds 5, 2, 7, 3. Its maximum is max(5, 2, 7, 3) = 7.
Level 1, cell (0, 1). The block at rows 0 to 1 and columns 1 to 2 holds 2, 9, 3, 6. Its maximum is max(2, 9, 3, 6) = 9.
Level 1, cell (0, 2). The block at rows 0 to 1 and columns 2 to 3 holds 9, 1, 6, 8. Its maximum is max(9, 1, 6, 8) = 9.
Level 1, cell (1, 0). The block at rows 1 to 2 and columns 0 to 1 holds 7, 3, 4, 10. Its maximum is max(7, 3, 4, 10) = 10.
Level 1, cell (1, 1). The block at rows 1 to 2 and columns 1 to 2 holds 3, 6, 10, 2. Its maximum is max(3, 6, 10, 2) = 10.
Level 1, cell (1, 2). The block at rows 1 to 2 and columns 2 to 3 holds 6, 8, 2, 12. Its maximum is max(6, 8, 2, 12) = 12.
Level 1, cell (2, 0). The block at rows 2 to 3 and columns 0 to 1 holds 4, 10, 11, 1. Its maximum is max(4, 10, 11, 1) = 11.
Level 1, cell (2, 1). The block at rows 2 to 3 and columns 1 to 2 holds 10, 2, 1, 5. Its maximum is max(10, 2, 1, 5) = 10.
Level 1, cell (2, 2). The block at rows 2 to 3 and columns 2 to 3 holds 2, 12, 5, 3. Its maximum is max(2, 12, 5, 3) = 12.
Level 1 is complete: a 3 by 3 table, one cell for each 2 by 2 block that fits in the grid.
Level 2, cell (0, 0). The 4 by 4 block at row 0, column 0 is four level-1 blocks of side 2, at offsets 0 and 2 in each direction. Its maximum is max(7, 9, 11, 12) = 12.
Level 2 is complete: a 1 by 1 table, one cell for each 4 by 4 block that fits in the grid.
The whole 4 by 4 grid is one block of side 4 at level 2, so the four lookups are the same cell. The answer is 12.

The whole 5 by 5 grid has side 5. The largest power of two that fits is 4, so four level-2 blocks, at offsets 0 and 1, cover it. Their maximum is max(12, 12, 12, 12) = 12.
